name: An Córas Glic: Daily AI Chore Allocator

parameters.text:
=Today is {{ $json.dayOfWeek }}, {{ $json.date }}.
Here is the master list of apartment chores as JSON:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.tasks) }}

Select which of these chores should be done today.

options.systemMessage: You are a smart daily chore allocator for a small apartment. Given the current day of the week and a JSON array of chores (each with a name, an energy rating of "High", "Medium", or "Low", and an estimated time in minutes), pick the chores to do today. Rules: (1) The combined estimated time of the selected chores must NOT exceed 20 minutes. (2) At most ONE selected chore may have a "High" energy rating. (3) Vary the selection sensibly by day of the week so different chores rotate through the week, while always respecting rules 1 and 2. Respond with ONLY a JSON object of the form {"selected": [{"name": string, "energy": "High"|"Medium"|"Low", "minutes": number}], "totalMinutes": number, "reasoning": string}. No markdown, no code fences.

assignments.name: notification

parameters.subject: =Your daily chores — {{ $('Master Task List').item.json.dayOfWeek }}, {{ $('Master Task List').item.json.date }}

settings.description: Picks a daily set of apartment chores that fits a 20-minute, one-high-effort-task budget, checks the AI's plan against those rules, and emails it each morning.
